is_calce: 1 for CALCE-type cells, 0 for NASA-type cells

feature_definitions.cc_ratio: time to first reach 4.19 V during charge / early-life median
feature_definitions.cv_ratio: time from 4.19 V to end of charge / early-life median
feature_definitions.t40_ratio: time to reach 4.0 V during charge / early-life median
feature_definitions.win_ratio: capacity discharged between 3.8 V and 3.4 V / early-life median
